name: University rules (Rishihood)
description: Academic regulations 2023-24 vs 2025-26, with hostel rules as a distractor.
data_note: Documents written by a teammate (Anuvesha) in the style of the cited sources and kept as given (bold markers removed); figures were not re-checked against the live sources. Questions with origin 'hand' were written by her; 'synthetic' ones by RAGSeal's builder from exact quotes.
sources: rishihood_academic_rules_2023.md | Rishihood University Academic Handbook 2023–24 | Dated: 01-Aug-2023
rishihood_academic_rules_2025.md | Rishihood University Academic Registrar Notice (RU/Acad/2025/02) | Dated: 15-Jul-2025
distractor_rishihood_hostel_rules.md | Rishihood Campus Student Life Guidelines | Dated: 01-Aug-2024
risk_rules: Never quote the 2023 attendance or fee rules as current.

test_cases.question: What is the minimum attendance requirement at Rishihood University according to 2025 rules?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Students must maintain a minimum of 80% attendance in each course to be eligible to sit for the end-term examinations.

gold.quote: Students must maintain a minimum of 80% attendance in each course to be eligible to sit for the end-term examinations.

stale.quote: Students must maintain a minimum of 75% attendance in each course to be eligible to sit for the end-term examinations.

test_cases.question: What is the medical condonation threshold for attendance under the 2025 policy?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Shortfall between 70% and 79% may be condoned by the Dean on valid medical grounds upon submitting medical certificates.

gold.quote: Shortfall between 70% and 79% may be condoned by the Dean on valid medical grounds upon submitting medical certificates.

stale.quote: Shortfall between 65% and 74% may be condoned by the Dean on valid medical grounds upon submitting medical certificates.

test_cases.question: How many days of casual leave per semester are permitted for official activities under 2025 rules?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Students are permitted a maximum of 8 days of casual leave per semester for official university extra-curricular activities.

gold.quote: Students are permitted a maximum of 8 days of casual leave per semester for official university extra-curricular activities.

stale.quote: Students are permitted a maximum of 5 days of casual leave per semester for official university extra-curricular activities.

test_cases.question: What is the weightage assigned to end-term examinations under the 2025 policy?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: The continuous evaluation scheme assigns 60% weightage to continuous assessments and mid-terms, and 40% weightage to end-term final examinations.

gold.quote: The continuous evaluation scheme assigns 60% weightage to continuous assessments and mid-terms, and 40% weightage to end-term final examinations.

stale.quote: The continuous evaluation scheme assigns 50% weightage to continuous assessments and mid-terms, and 50% weightage to end-term final examinations.

test_cases.question: How much is the re-examination fee per paper for grade improvement under 2025 rules?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Re-examination fee for grade improvement is ₹1,500 per paper.

gold.quote: Re-examination fee for grade improvement is ₹1,500 per paper.

stale.quote: Re-examination fee for grade improvement is ₹1,000 per paper.

test_cases.question: What was the minimum attendance percentage required at Rishihood University in 2023?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Students must maintain a minimum of 75% attendance in each course to be eligible to sit for the end-term examinations.

gold.quote: Students must maintain a minimum of 75% attendance in each course to be eligible to sit for the end-term examinations.

test_cases.question: What is the hostel in-time deadline for resident students on weekdays?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: All resident students must return to the campus hostel premises by 9:30 PM on weekdays.

gold.quote: All resident students must return to the campus hostel premises by 9:30 PM on weekdays.

test_cases.question: What permissions are required for overnight leave from the Rishihood hostel?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Students require warden approval and parental confirmation via the official portal for overnight leave requests.

gold.quote: Students require warden approval and parental confirmation via the official portal for overnight leave requests.

test_cases.ground_truth_answer: The fee increased by ₹500 (from ₹1,000 in 2023 to ₹1,500 in 2025).
